chunks: Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you like the calling of one another to another. Indeed, Allah knows those who slip away from you surreptitiously. So let those who act in contravention of his command take heed lest a trial befall them or a grievous punishment come upon them.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between summoning the Prophet and summoning each other according to Surah An-Nur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the distinct authority of the Prophet (SAWW) by contrasting the formal summons 'Yad'u' used for him with the casual 'Yad'u' used among peers, underscoring his unique status as the ultimate authority. It warns against those who secretly evade his commands, linking this disobedience to a specific 'fitnah' (trial or affliction) and 'adhab alim' (painful punishment), which Shia scholars often interpret as a divine consequence for rejecting his leadership and guidance.
